entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Mother of Chandra Nalaar and widow of Kiran, a Kaladesh inventor who led the Renegades and later became Consul and Indigo Revolution leader.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Pia's daughter, a fire mage and planeswalker.

entities.name: Kiran Nalaar
entities.description: Pia's husband, killed when Captain Baral burned Burarat.

entities.name: Captain Baral
entities.description: Consulate captain who burned Burarat and taunted Pia in her cell.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker and Head Judge at the Inventors' Fair who dueled Pia as bait for Chandra.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: Head inspector who sent gearhulks against Chandra.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Chandra's friend who arrived with her at the Inventors' Fair.

entities.name: Gonti
entities.description: Who promised aid in taking the Aether Hub.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: Planeswalker who tortured Pia to feed on Chandra's agony.

entities.name: Saheeli
entities.description: Ally who confirmed the Phyrexian interest in the aetherflux reservoir.

entities.name: The Consulate
entities.description: The ruling body of Kaladesh that Pia challenged.

entities.name: The Renegades
entities.description: Rebels in Ghirapur led by Pia.

entities.name: Aether Rangers
entities.description: Team Pia founded and co-led in the second Ghirapur Grand Prix.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion of the multiverse, including Ghirapur.

entities.name: Indigo Revolution
entities.description: A reform movement that installed the Avishkar Assembly, in which Pia was instrumental.

events.summary: Captain Baral's troops burned Burarat, killing Kiran, taking Chandra to be executed and jailing Pia.
events.quote: Kiran was killed, Chandra was taken away to be executed and Pia was jailed.

events.summary: Pia vowed to challenge the Consulate and steer it from tyranny.
events.quote: vowing to challenge the Consulate and steer it away from tyranny and oppression

events.summary: Tezzeret located Pia, Chandra appeared, and Dovin Baan sent gearhulks, so Pia turned herself in again.
events.quote: Pia willingly turned herself in again.

events.summary: Tezzeret staged a quicksmithing duel with Pia as bait for Chandra while he stole the inventions.
events.quote: Tezzeret set up a quicksmithing duel between himself and Pia

events.summary: The renegades attacked the Aether Hub and its personnel yielded.
events.quote: the renegades attacked the Aether Hub .

events.summary: After the revolution Pia became consul of Allocation.
events.quote: Pia Nalaar became the new consul of Allocation.

events.summary: Tibalt intruded into Pia's home and tortured her to feed on Chandra's agony.
events.quote: The planeswalker Tibalt intruded into Pia's home and tortured her as a way to feed on Chandra's agony.

events.summary: Pia and the artisans defended the aetherflux reservoir during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Pia and the artisans worked to defend the aetherflux reservoir

events.summary: Pia was instrumental in the Indigo Revolution that installed the Avishkar Assembly.
events.quote: She was instrumental in the Indigo Revolution that installed the Avishkar Assembly .

events.summary: Pia founded and co-led the Aether Rangers in the second Ghirapur Grand Prix.
events.quote: Pia founded and co-led the Aether Rangers in the second Ghirapur Grand Prix
